Ascension4.label: After a perfect counter
Ascension4.reason: Her Normal and Charged Attack bonus starts only after her Skill counters a hit at its maximum bonus, which depends on timing and on being attacked.

burst.label: Constellation 6 Elemental Mastery in her Burst (Stellar-Conduct)
burst.reason: A Constellation 6 Elemental Mastery bonus while her Burst lasts in a Stellar-Conduct party, which moves her damage only through a reaction. It needs the two Stellar switches as well.

lockRevelation.label: Stellar Revelation
lockRevelation.reason: A mode of the party that unlocks Stellar bonuses; the planner cannot tell whether it is on, so it is left for the player to switch on.

lockStellarRadianceSc.label: Stellar Radiance, Stellar-Conduct
lockStellarRadianceSc.reason: The kind of Stellar hits the party's mode makes; the planner cannot tell it, so it is left for the player to switch on.
